name: contabily
description: Aplicação de controle financeiro pessoal desenvolvida em Electron.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.build:unpack: npm run build && npm run rebuild:sqlite && electron-builder --dir
scripts.build:win: npm run build && npm run rebuild:sqlite && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:win32: npm run build && npm run rebuild:sqlite32 && electron-builder --win --ia32
scripts.build:win64: npm run build && npm run rebuild:sqlite64 && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.build:multi-win: npm run build && npm run rebuild:sqlite64 && npm run rebuild:sqlite32 && electron-builder --win --x64 --ia32
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && npm run rebuild:sqlite && electron-builder --linux
scripts.build:mac: npm run build && npm run rebuild:sqlite && electron-builder --mac
scripts.publish: npm run build && npm run rebuild:sqlite && electron-builder --win --publish always
scripts.publish:win: npm run build && npm run rebuild:sqlite && electron-builder --win --publish always
scripts.publish:mac: npm run build && npm run rebuild:sqlite && electron-builder --mac --publish always
scripts.publish:linux: npm run build && npm run rebuild:sqlite && electron-builder --linux --publish always
scripts.test: node --test tests/financial-validation.test.mjs tests/window-controls.test.mjs tests/month-range.test.mjs tests/report-filters.test.mjs tests/investments.test.mjs tests/notification-evaluation.test.mjs tests/entry-schedule.test.mjs tests/transaction-service.test.mjs tests/income-tax.test.mjs tests/auto-updater.test.mjs tests/shared-finance.test.mjs tests/ipc-authorization.test.mjs tests/external-data.test.mjs tests/recurring-schedule.test.mjs
